descriptionEn: A 2+1 apartment is offered for rent in Lagjja e Spitalit, Rruga A – Anna Residence complex.
A modern and functional apartment, fully furnished and never lived in before, offering the feeling of a fresh start. It is located on the 5th floor of the complex and has a working elevator.

Its layout includes a living room with kitchen, two bedrooms, one bathroom and a separate WC, as well as a hallway and a balcony with an open view. The garage is included for the convenience and security of the car.
With easy access and a favourable location in one of the sought-after areas of the city.
